risk_note: RV2 (identity + linking + app.module; contract: mergeAccount loses x-implementation planned and gains 10010 in x-error-codes, generated files regenerated; no migration). B1-20c plan couli-runs/B1-20c/plan.md; rulings D10-1099 (Q-1 current behaviour: orders reaching the source after the merge stay with the tombstone, shares to the platform — sent to the owner; Q-2 no claim; Q-3 any admin_adjustments row and Q-4 a blocked(admin_disable) binding make the source not empty → 30411, judged in merge and in bind-phone's ticket offer; Q-5 a frozen target is allowed; Q-6 the stored idempotency body has tokens nulled via B1-01zzs { archive }; T-1–T-9 incl. T-7), D10-1103 (a flagged target on an unverified device → 10010, judged before migrating, ticket not consumed), D10-1097 (union_pdd_pid_filings stay with the tombstone), D10-1112 (spec-test r3 one-off). Flow: ticket read in the idempotency transaction before any users lock; dormant re-verification judged and flagged in its own short committed transaction (target re-checked under lock: status normal and still holding the ticket's phone); users locked ascending (FOR NO KEY UPDATE) → consent lock → growth relation lock; all source / target conditions re-read under lock (source ban, session revoked → 10002); savepoint; user_oauth moved (merged_from_user_id); linking releaseForMerge (active / invalid → released, released_at = cooldown_until = now); source tombstone (deleted, merged), source sessions revoked; device_registrations.merged_into_user_id; completeLogin merge mode; ticket compare-and-delete last (failure → rollback, 50001). A lock-phase deadlock retries the whole request once (40P01), then 50001. T-7: taobao authorisation submit and the PDD filing refresh refuse a tombstone; PDD open activation (pdd-authority) is outside the paths → FU-MERGE-PDD-OPEN-TOMBSTONE. Full verification is the required CI checks (approvals 21).
